description_en: Calls ListCampaigns to obtain the list of predictive dialing campaigns under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListCampaigns获取指定实例下的预测式外呼活动列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-campaigns --instance-id ccc-test --state Draft --name test-campaign --planed-start-time-from 1780243200000 --planed-start-time-to 1781798399000 --actual-start-time-from 1780329600000 --actual-start-time-to 1781625600000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --queue-id skillgroup@ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCampaigns
